name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon
address: 5F, Bellavita, 28 Songren Road, Xinyi District, Taipei
addressZh: 信義區松仁路28號5樓 (寶麗廣場)
dinnerNote: Dinner menu with the snow crab and caviar course (NT$4,980 without it)
dinnerNoteZh: 晚間套餐，含經典蟹肉魚子醬（不含則4,980元）
lunchNote: Menu A, weekday lunch (Menu B NT$2,980, Menu C NT$3,880)
lunchNoteZh: A組合套餐，平日午餐（B組合2,980元，C組合3,880元）

menus.name: Dinner menu with the snow crab and caviar course
menus.note: Amuse-bouche, snow crab with Oscietra caviar, three starters, a choice of Wagyu or Iberico pork, two desserts, coffee or tea; wine is the sommelier's four-glass selection (two glasses NT$1,380, three NT$1,980)

menus.name: Dinner menu
menus.note: The same menu without the snow crab and caviar course

menus.name: Menu C
menus.note: Amuse-bouche, two starters, two main courses, dessert or cheese, coffee or tea, chosen from the set-menu list; some dishes cost extra

menus.name: Menu B
menus.note: Amuse-bouche, two starters, one main course, dessert or cheese, coffee or tea, chosen from the set-menu list; some dishes cost extra

menus.name: Menu A
menus.note: Weekday lunch only, not on public holidays: amuse-bouche, one starter, one main course, dessert or cheese, coffee or tea

alsoTry.name: Le Salon de Thé de Joël Robuchon
alsoTry.note: The Robuchon tea salon and bakery in the same building

bookingOpens: Online through inline, or by phone. Online bookings take parties of up to six; some time slots ask for a deposit.
groups: Parties of more than six book by phone.
children: Children aged 7 and over at dinner.
